services.name: Party package
services.desc: YMCA Camp Sloper, with 143 acres of woods, fields, Sloper Pond, and other great program facilities, is the perfect place for your child to have a birthday celebration with friends. Parties are available for members and non-members. Bookings are accepted for Saturdays and Sundays in a two hour time frame at 3 different party times: 10am-12pm, 1pm-3pm, and 4pm-6pm. Parties are priced for up to 20 children, with a minimum of one adult chaperone required, and include the private use of a designated pavilion.
